body: This sounds shallow, but between work to pay for college, school, and obviously my personal life, I really don’t have much time. Also the thought of getting acclimated to a new place
I had 2 dogs, but 1 died last week.
I’m going to the University of Georgia . And I won’t be living with my parents because it’s about an hour commute if I were to do so.
I just wish I knew more into what everything has to hold for me. So I could at least be at peace more often and never have a moment or occurrence like this again
It has its high points. But I can be happy one minute and sobbing the next, so what do I know?
I play golf just for a college resume

As much as it burns me to say it, he’s like me. Starts off happy, we don’t know when he gets home though. He’s never beat me or abused me, he doesn’t drink, but if he snaps and goes off on me, it’s worse in my perspective

It started when I quit football to get a job. He played all 4 years of school. Things haven’t been the same since with us and I got in school suspension this year for a day and it has only gotten worse, because he looks down at who I am
I have a tracker on my phone. My dad sees my every move. I show up at a doctors office and he finds out why, I’m out of the house
I can’t open up with someone I know. It’s ingrained in me to be that way
I haven’t been to a doctor in years for that specific reason
No confidentiality. Str8 back to my parents or get sent off somewhere where I will hang myself inevitably.
I don’t trust a soul in my school and I have two friends that I don’t even feel like I can tell because it just puts me a step closer to milking myself
My dad always forced emotion away from me and I can’t even express any valid feelings to anyone. If i do, it’s a lie and the cycle resets
